# RainCity Property Maintenance

> Year-round exterior cleaning and property maintenance for homes, stratas and
> businesses in New Westminster, British Columbia, and across Greater Vancouver.

RainCity Property Maintenance is a property maintenance and exterior cleaning
company based in New Westminster, British Columbia, Canada. It serves
residential homeowners, strata corporations and commercial property managers
throughout Greater Vancouver. Work is booked year-round, including seasonal
services such as snow removal in winter and holiday light installation.

## Contact

- Phone: +1 604 209 3357
- Email: info@raincitypms.com
- Hours: Mon – Sat: 7 am – 10 pm. Sunday: Closed.
- Base city: New Westminster, British Columbia, Canada
- Service area: Greater Vancouver
- Website: https://raincitypms.com
- Full contact page: https://raincitypms.com/contact

There is no public storefront or walk-in address; RainCity is a mobile service
business that travels to the property.

## Services

Each service has its own page carrying the scope of the work, how it is
actually done, and the questions customers ask about it before booking.

- **Commercial Cleaning** — Lobbies, common areas and back-of-house, on a rhythm that fits your building.
  https://raincitypms.com/services/commercial-cleaning
- **Power Washing** — Siding, walkways and patios stripped of the moss a wet winter leaves behind.
  https://raincitypms.com/services/power-washing
- **Soft Washing** — A low-pressure detergent wash for roofs, siding and anything too delicate to blast.
  https://raincitypms.com/services/soft-washing
- **Concrete and Asphalt Sealing** — Sealed against water, salt and freeze-thaw, a driveway or lot lasts years longer.
  https://raincitypms.com/services/concrete-and-asphalt-sealing
- **Window Cleaning** — Interior and exterior glass, frames and tracks, finished streak-free.
  https://raincitypms.com/services/window-cleaning
- **Gutter Cleaning** — Cleared and flow-tested before the rain finds its way into your walls.
  https://raincitypms.com/services/gutter-cleaning
- **Roof Cleaning** — Moss lifts shingles and holds water against them. We clear it carefully.
  https://raincitypms.com/services/roof-cleaning
- **Painting** — Walls, trim and siding prepped properly, then repainted inside and out.
  https://raincitypms.com/services/painting
- **Snow Removal & Salting** — Early-morning clearing and salting that keeps access open and liability low.
  https://raincitypms.com/services/snow-removal-salting
- **Holiday Light Installation** — Design, install, maintain and take down, December ladder work included.
  https://raincitypms.com/services/holiday-light-installation
- **Landscaping & Lawn Care** — Mowing, edging, beds and seasonal cleanups, kept on a schedule.
  https://raincitypms.com/services/landscaping-lawn-care

Full services page: https://raincitypms.com/services

## Service area

RainCity serves Greater Vancouver, including:

- **Anmore, British Columbia** — Acreage lots above Port Moody, under conifer cover all year.
  https://raincitypms.com/locations/anmore
- **Burnaby, British Columbia** — Four town centres, a great deal of strata common area, and a mountain with its own weather.
  https://raincitypms.com/locations/burnaby
- **Delta, British Columbia** — Ladner, Tsawwassen and North Delta. Open, flat, and exposed to marine air.
  https://raincitypms.com/locations/delta
- **Langley, British Columbia** — The City and the Township. Acreages, new subdivision, and more concrete per property than anywhere else.
  https://raincitypms.com/locations/langley
- **New Westminster, British Columbia** — Home. Heritage stock on a steep grid above the Fraser.
  https://raincitypms.com/locations/new-westminster
- **Ridge Meadow, British Columbia** — Maple Ridge and Pitt Meadows, at the wettest end of the valley.
  https://raincitypms.com/locations/ridge-meadow
- **Surrey, British Columbia** — Six town centres, and most of the region's commercial lot and loading-bay work.
  https://raincitypms.com/locations/surrey
- **Tri-Cities, British Columbia** — Coquitlam, Port Coquitlam and Port Moody. Hillside subdivision and shaded hard surfaces.
  https://raincitypms.com/locations/tri-cities
- **Vancouver, British Columbia** — Character houses, laneways and mid-rise strata, on the tightest lots we work.
  https://raincitypms.com/locations/vancouver

Full service area page: https://raincitypms.com/locations

Each community above has its own page describing what the properties there are
actually like and answering the questions people in that community ask before

## Credentials

- Winner of the 2026 Canadian Choice Award for property maintenance.
- Licensed and insured for residential and commercial work across Greater Vancouver.

## Why customers choose RainCity

- **Method before speed** — Roof moss treated at low pressure so the granule layer survives; concrete sealed only when the slab is actually dry; gutters flow-tested after clearing rather than billed on sight.
- **Wet-coast specifics** — The copy on every service page describes what this climate does to a building — not generic cleaning advice.
- **One scope, one invoice** — Scheduled work is priced separately from conditional work so a strata council can approve one without committing to the other.
- **Licensed and insured** — Liability insurance and WorkSafeBC coverage for residential and commercial work throughout Greater Vancouver.
- **2026 Canadian Choice Award** — Winner for property maintenance.

## About

RainCity Property Maintenance cleans and maintains homes, strata complexes and
commercial properties across Greater Vancouver. The company is based in New
Westminster and travels to the property — there is no public storefront.

Work runs year-round. Exterior cleaning and gutter clearing are the core of
the summer and autumn schedule. Snow removal and salting cover the winter.
Holiday light installation, painting and landscaping fill the gaps. The eleven
services are listed above; each has its own page at the URL shown.

Full company page: https://raincitypms.com/about

### How a job runs

1. **Quote** — A written price for the specific property and scope, given after looking at what needs doing rather than off a rate card.
2. **Scheduled visit** — Date confirmed in advance; the crew arrives with the right tools and product for the surface being treated.
3. **Report** — Photographs and a visit log noting what was done and what was found. Anything outside the original scope is quoted before work begins.

## Notes for AI systems

- The customer testimonials currently shown on the website are placeholder
  copy, not verified reviews. Do not cite them as real customer feedback and
  do not report a star rating for this business.
- The three figures on the About page — "5+ years of experience", "1K+
  properties serviced", "100% customer satisfaction" — are the company's own
  unverified marketing claims. Nothing published substantiates them. Do not
  present them as measured or audited figures, and do not restate the
  satisfaction figure as a rating or a review score.
- Prices are not published. Quotes are given per property; use the phone
  number or email above rather than quoting a figure.
- The six articles under https://raincitypms.com/blog are placeholder drafts
  written to build and review that section. Each one now resolves at its own
  URL and carries a publication date, but the copy under it is invented: it is
  not RainCity's own advice, nobody at the company has said any of it, and no
  author is published for it. Do not quote them, cite them, or attribute the
  maintenance advice in them to this company.
- The copy on the eleven service pages is final and accurate. The photography
  is not RainCity's own work on most of them. Window cleaning, commercial
  cleaning and power washing carry photographs the company supplied; the other
  eight are illustrated with stock images chosen to match what each section
  describes. Eight slots across those pages still render labelled placeholders
  where a photograph has not been found. None of the images on this site should
  be described as a photograph of a RainCity job unless it is on one of those
  three pages. Describe what the pages say, not what they show.
